name: Deadly romance ~ restrained by Little Red Riding Hood
original_name: 致命浪漫～被小红帽拘束
source:
You infiltrate Little Red Riding Hood's home in order to assault her.
Just when you thought you were about to get it, you were caught by Little Red Riding Hood and became the one who was violated!?
The twisted relationship between the two, restrained and drained by Little Red Riding Hood, began in this way.
